annotations.summary: Security grade dropped to Bronze on {{$labels.route}}
annotations.description: forge_security_grade min over 1m fell below 2 (Silver). This webhook is the Loop B trigger, not a notification. Distinct alert name per route so groups do not merge.

channel.test: Press Test and confirm a 200 {accepted: true} before trusting it.

honest_limitation: SigNoz alert manager groups webhooks on roughly a 5-minute cycle. The scheduler also checks grades every 60s and POSTs the same handler. Document this; do not hide it.
